title: Kian and the Super-Eyes
markdown:
Dawn cracked open! Brilliant gold splashed Kian the Boat Fixer's workshop windows. Sunshine streamed in, a warm, liquid hug. Kian stretched, arms reaching high, high, HIGH! "Today feels AMAZING!" he boomed, bouncing on his toes. Outside, Dottie the Duck was already a blur of bright yellow. "Quack! Quack! Kian! Uncle Hari! Quick! Come see NOW!"

Uncle Hari padded out, his smile as warm as toast. "What's the big fuss, little Dottie?" his voice rumbled, deep and kind.

Dottie pointed a flappy wing at moss by the pond. It was fuzzy green. "Look! Tiny creatures! Wiggling! I KNOW IT!" She dipped her beak. All she saw was green fuzz. Kian grabbed his magnifying glass. He peeked. "WHOA! Legs! Wriggling bits! They zip so fast!" he gasped. "Speedy, speedy specks!" Dottie pouted.

"Hmm," Uncle Hari tapped his chin. He loved puzzles. "Sometimes, we need extra sparkle." Back in his workshop, he pulled out a dusty box. Glass circles gleamed. He picked a fat, round one. "Let's try this."

Kian held it over the moss. "Wow! Bigger!" The fuzz puffed up. He saw tiny paths. But the creatures still zipped away. "Ah, yes. This bends light a bit," Uncle Hari chuckled. "For super-specks, we need THIS!" He handed Kian a light, clear lens, smooth like a tiny puddle.

Kian's heart drummed a rapid beat. He held the lens close. WOW! A secret door! Gigantic fuzzy things with tons of legs marched on mossy highways. Jewel-bright beetles gleamed. Moss-babies nibbled giant leaves. These weren't specks! They were HUGE, busy beings!

"Look!" Dottie quacked. "That one carries a leaf bigger than him!"

Kian grinned. "A whole new world down there, Uncle Hari!" he whispered. A tiny creature sparkled like glitter!

Uncle Hari beamed. "That lens is a magnifier. It helps us see tiny things. It makes them BIGGER."

"Super-eyes!" Kian declared, steadying the powerful lens.

"Exactly!" Uncle Hari beamed. "The world has tiny wonders. Magnifiers help us see them! What else can we magnify?" Dottie puffed her feathers. "Under the big daisy!" Kian's eyes sparked. "Me too! What other secrets are hiding?" And with a shared grin, they peered at the sun-drenched garden, ready for their next amazing discovery.
characters: Kian the boat fixer, Dottie the duck, Uncle Hari
